corrections.chicken: Set the rotated body cube pivot to the body bone pivot [0, 8, 0].
corrections.dolphin: Java 1.21 DolphinEntityModel geometry and UVs, inspected from the local client model.
corrections.ender_dragon: Mirror right wing and wingtip geometry.
corrections.fox: Java 48x32 UV layout for head, ears, nose, body, tail and legs; awake head only.
corrections.guardian_family: Static extended spikes, eye and tail placement.
corrections.ravager: Java body, neck, head and leg geometry; torso raised one pixel to meet leg tops.
corrections.sheep: Restored standing head height to align with the body and wool.
corrections.spiders: Spread resting leg attachments and angles for distinct leg pairs.
corrections.trader_llama: Trader decoration layer over the base coat.
corrections.villager: Default plains farmer clothing and straw hat layers.
